proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL bhrātṛ explicitly gives Maiya žā, ky. ẓā and Chiliss ẓā brother, matching the selected younger-brother forms without additional morphology. The younger restriction is a survey sense, and the article also documents younger-brother usage in other NIA reflexes. Preserve postalveolar/retroflex notation; local IA transmission is not resolved. Exact response: žā.
